description: Estimates how many US dollars arrive in a Poplin account when someone pays into its receiving bank account in another currency, with the rate, the fees and the deposit limits, for personal and business accounts at standard pricing. Use it when someone asks what they would receive for a payment in a currency such as EUR or GBP. It is an estimate; the final terms are shown in the Poplin app.
name: get_receive_quote
title: Receive quote
